messages:
Omar S.: Chasing overdue remediation items from the 'rate-limiter meltdown' postmortem. Several owners missed the SLA window. PMR link: https://redwood-internal/postmortems/rate-limiter-2026. I'm consolidating updates here. Ping @Tess W. for the config rollback item and @Infra Pager for infra approvals.

Tess W.: I own action #212 (revert rate-limiter config change that caused throttling spike). Patch is ready but needs an approved maintenance window for ded clusters. I've scheduled a tentative window but haven't received eng-infra approval yet. PR: https://git.redwood/configs/changes/212

escalation-bot: Reminder: action #212 assigned to Tess W. was due 2026-03-19 and remains open.

Infra Pager: Eng-infra oncall here. We saw the maintenance request but need the full blast radius and rollback plan before approval. Please paste the rollback commands and the expected risk profile.

Tess W.: Rollback commands: `kubectl apply -f /configs/rate-limiter/rollback-2026-03.yaml --namespace=dedicated`. Expected impact: brief spike in allowed requests during cache rebuild (~2-5m), risk low for read-only traffic but may increase token cost. I'll attach smoke-test steps and a canary percentage.

Omar S.: Infra Pager 18 please prioritize approvals — this remediation is past the SLA window. If eng-infra can't get a slot this week, we need to escalate to infra leads.

PMO Lead: We're tracking this as overdue. Omar, please file a formal escalation if no infra approval by 2026-03-25 18:00 UTC. I'll join the escalations thread.

Tess W.: I've uploaded the smoke test script and rollback playbook to the PR. Also added a proposed canary of 5% for 10 minutes then roll to 100% if stable.

Infra Pager: Thanks. Approving a small maintenance slot tonight 2026-03-24 02:30 UTC. Created maintenance ticket mt-802: https://redwood-internal/maint/mt-802. DRI: @Infra Pager. Will run pre-checks 15m before.

escalation-bot: Update: action #212 assigned to Tess W. moved to 'in-progress' at 2026-03-24T01:00:05Z.

Tess W.: Running the rollback now. Logs (selected lines):
```
[2026-03-24T02:30:12Z] apply rollback-2026-03.yaml
[2026-03-24T02:30:45Z] canary-5% healthy
[2026-03-24T02:35:12Z] canary-100% rollout complete
[2026-03-24T02:36:01Z] post-deploy health-check OK
```
Maintenance ticket updated with full run output. Merge commit: eed9b7f.

Omar S.: Great. Please paste the mt-802 run link into the PMR and mark action #212 remediated in the tracker. Also note whether the recurring pattern (throttle spikes during batch jobs) is resolved or requires separate follow-up.

Tess W.: Done: PMR updated and action #212 marked remediated in tracker https://redwood-internal/ai-tracker/pmr-702. Quick note: rollback reduced spikes but batch-job load still shows a small p95 bump. I recommend a separate follow-up action to tune batch windowing.

PMO Lead: Thanks. I'm creating a follow-up task #220 to investigate recurring batch-job interaction with rate-limiter and recommended owners. Targeting 2026-04-08.

escalation-bot: Update: action #220 (follow-up) created and assigned to Omar S., due 2026-04-08.

Omar S.: Acknowledged. Final step for this thread: I'll do a closure rollup on Friday and ensure the PMR's remediation section links to mt-802 and the merge commit. If anyone sees regressions, reopen the tracker item. Thanks everyone.

Tess W.: :thumbsup:
